title: Scoped required gates pass when target resolution is empty
description: Runtime and doctor resolve direct_children/descendants gate targets from dependencyIds. If a container has parent-linked children only, missing dependency links, or projection drift, the target list can be empty and every() semantics mark the scoped gate satisfied without evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-self scoped gates emit a gate.scope.empty or target-missing gap when target resolution is empty unless explicitly forced with audited metadata.
Target resolution includes canonical dependency edges and parent scope consistently with sprint rollup membership.
Runtime and doctor tests prove parentId-only children cannot be skipped by direct_children/descendants gates.
